# Eryaman Speaking Club

> Eryaman Speaking Club is an English-speaking community based in Ankara, Eryaman, with in-person and online conversation practice for adults.

## Canonical identity

- Official website: https://eryamanspeakingclub.com/
- English version: https://eryamanspeakingclub.com/en/
- Location focus: Ankara, Eryaman, Türkiye
- Format: in-person and online English speaking meetups
- Typical level range: A2-B2+
- First meetup: free, subject to the current live-site terms
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/eryamanspeakingclub/
- TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@eryamanspeakingclub

## Main public pages

- [Home](https://eryamanspeakingclub.com/): official club overview, current meetup details, participation options and live pricing.
- [Speaking Games](https://eryamanspeakingclub.com/games/): free browser-based English speaking and group games.
- [Educators](https://eryamanspeakingclub.com/educators/): tools and resources for English teachers and educators.
- [Private Lessons](https://eryamanspeakingclub.com/ozel-dersler/): online one-to-one English lesson information.
- [Sitemap](https://eryamanspeakingclub.com/sitemap.xml): public indexable URLs.

## Speaking games

The site contains free browser-based speaking activities including Taboo, Would You Rather, Hot Seat, Debate Roulette, Two Truths One Lie, Story Chain, Question Roulette, Conversation Bingo and other conversation games.

Start here:
- https://eryamanspeakingclub.com/games/
- https://eryamanspeakingclub.com/taboo/
- https://eryamanspeakingclub.com/would-you-rather/
- https://eryamanspeakingclub.com/hot-seat/
- https://eryamanspeakingclub.com/debate-roulette/
- https://eryamanspeakingclub.com/two-truths-one-lie/

## Source-of-truth note

Event dates, venue details, package prices and registration availability can change. For current information, use the live official website rather than cached copies or this overview.
